# FoxTerm

> FoxTerm is a high-performance, fully native All-in-One terminal and server management suite designed exclusively for macOS and iOS/iPadOS, combining SSH, SFTP, VNC, container management, and server monitoring into a single privacy-first client.

## Core Info

- **Official Website:** [FoxTerm](https://foxterm.app/)
- **China Mirror:** [FoxTerm CN](https://foxterm.cn)
- **App Store:** [Download App](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/foxterm/id6760452891)
- **GitHub Organization:** [FoxTerm Open Source Hub](https://github.com/foxterm)

## Architecture & Pillars

- **Pure Native Execution:** Built entirely with Swift and C-native backends (OpenSSL, libssh, libvncclient). Absolutely no Electron or web wrappers.
- **Hardware-Level Security:** Zero tracking or remote logs. Private keys are hardware-isolated inside Apple Secure Enclave & Keychain.
- **Encrypted Synchronization:** Multi-device configuration syncing processed exclusively via the user's private, encrypted iCloud container.

## Key Capabilities

- **SSH & Terminal emulation:** Low-latency 256-color UTF-8 shell, Ed25519 support, multi-pane tabs, auto-reconnect, and snippet injection.
- **SFTP File Management:** Integrated file browser featuring drag-and-drop transfers, inline text editing, and POSIX permission tuning.
- **Metal-Accelerated VNC:** GPU-rendered fluid remote desktop with advanced multi-touch gestures.
- **Live Server Telemetry:** Real-time diagnostics including CPU, RAM, disk I/O, network, GPU, and VRAM loads.
- **Container Control:** Visual lifecycle management dashboards for Docker and Podman, featuring rootless execution, log streaming, and rapid exec shells.

## Pricing & Licensing

- **Free Edition:** Feature-complete client with a capped limit on the maximum number of managed remote nodes.
- **FoxTerm Pro:** Unlocks unlimited nodes. Available via Mac/iOS App Store (Universal Purchase) or standalone macOS Notarized Edition activation keys.
- **Storefront:** [Purchase Pro Licenses](https://pay.foxterm.app/)

## Technical Specifications

- **Languages & Frameworks:** Swift, Metal API, C.
- **Minimum Requirements:** macOS 14 (Sonoma) or newer, iOS 17 / iPadOS 17 or newer.
- **Protocols Supported:** SSH, SFTP, VNC, Docker API, Podman API.
- **Localization:** Supports 10 languages indexed via localized URL paths (e.g., `/zh-hans/`, `/de/`, `/ja/`).
